audience: store owners who sell digital goods and licence keys on Sellize

useCases.title: Check orders and stock each week
useCases.text: List the newest orders, filtered by status or creation time. Then list products to see the stock counts of automatic products.

useCases.title: Refill a licence key product from a list
useCases.text: Add up to 1000 keys to an automatic product's stock in one call. Items already in the stock are skipped. Check a key first to see if it was sold.

useCases.title: Create a discount coupon for a promotion
useCases.text: Create a percentage or fixed coupon. Buyers can use it at once, so check the list of coupons first.

useCases.title: Look up a buyer and a licence key
useCases.text: Find a customer by email. List the newest orders, then check whether a licence key was sold, refunded or disputed.

useCases.title: Draft a new product and publish it
useCases.text: Create a product, which starts as a draft. Update its price or status when it is ready. An active product is visible to buyers at once.
